title: 第17章 白虎遗骨第18章 来自于面具的力量
content_zh:
族山，一条由荒石打造的宽阔台阶，拾阶而上直达山巅。
一人一狗同时仰望山巅，少年深邃的黑眸有着些许期待，“山上应该是余氏曾经的家族祭祀台，希望那道白虎真魂还在！”
余烬正要登山巅，台阶前方的一尊白虎雕像之上，忽然抖落无数灰尘，灰尘当中一道蹲在雕像上的身影诡异出现。
那人在白虎雕像上缓缓站起，露出一套绯红色的武将铠甲，脸上还覆盖着一副飞鼠面甲，浑身上下只有一双冷漠的眼睛暴露出来。
老黄狗呜咽一声躲在了余烬脚边，而余烬巍然不动的站着。
绯红武将那双冷漠的瞳孔扫视过余烬，手掌按向腰间的短剑剑柄，却在目光落在余烬腰间的白虎牌上时，突然歪了歪脑袋，沉默了半响之后，他又缓缓坐了回去，那双冷漠的眼睛闭起来的瞬间，似乎再度变成了一座不会动的石雕!
余烬缓缓吐了一口气，从离开那一老一小之后，他一路上遇见了不下十次的暗中窥视，可眼看着对方就要出手的时候，只要他故意摸一摸腰间的白虎牌，那些窥视就会悄然退下！~
那叫余昆仑的小子，看来并没有说谎，山里的人似乎都忌惮着他腰间的牌牌，同时他心中更是捏了一把冷汗，要是没有这白虎牌，哪怕进了族山恐怕也走不远！
余烬抬脚迈上石阶，刚走几步，身后的老黄狗正要跟上，突然一柄短剑插在前方，上面流淌的元力波动，直接将老黄狗轰飞出去！
余烬回过身，看了眼绯红武将，又看向远处并无大碍的老黄狗，说道：“老黄，你就先待在这里，我自己一个人上去就行了。”
老黄狗呜咽了一声，趴伏在地上不敢再动。
余烬一个人开始向上攀登，宽阔的荒石台阶两边，立着许多许多形态各异的石雕，余烬发现除了绯红武将身下的三目白虎，其余的石雕他或多或少见过，而他认出来的无一例外都是大荒城各个家族势力的象征。
就像余氏家族的象征是三目白虎，这里有涅骨宗的通天骨蟒、王家的火睛狮、昊天武馆的食剑猿……等等！
许久之后，当余烬到达山巅，映入眼帘的是一座宽广的山巅平台，一尊巨大无比的猛兽骸骨屹立在大地之上。
猛兽骸骨通体光滑雪白，骨架上的每一根骨头都带着一股古老而久远的气息，宛如小山般的猛兽头颅向着高空注视，眉心处有着有个奇异的竖痕空洞。
当余烬站在下方的时候，一种来自远古的凶戾气息扑面而来，那瞬间他仿佛看见一头虎啸长空的恐怖巨兽！
这正是一尊三目白虎的骸骨！
“余氏传承千年，甚至比当今的武朝皇室也差不了多少，传说当年的初代先祖身边，是一头真正的三目白虎，难道眼前这个就是……”
余烬仰头观望，他虽然内心并不喜余氏，可脸上依旧有着几分掩饰不住的震撼。
“确实是三目白虎的遗骸，但却不是那头十恶真灵……有点可惜。”神秘面具的声音在脑海中响起。

余烬收敛心神，“十恶真灵是什么？”
“十恶真灵是星空宇宙当中最……”面具回答的声音转为戏谑，“你这小蝼蚁还不配知道，既然这里有三目白虎的遗骸，还不抓紧时间去寻找真魂的踪迹，浪费本尊的时间！”
余烬：……
接下来的时间，余烬搜索了整个山巅，可惜翻了一遍又一遍依旧一无所获，甚至拿草芥剑在白虎遗骸上斩了七八下，那所谓的白虎真魂也并没有现身。
“难道真的消失了？”余烬皱起眉头，世间所有的灵魂体脱离了肉身，都无法做到永世长存，哪怕是再特殊的手段，也只是拖延时间的长短而已。
content_en:
Clan Mountain, a wide staircase made of waste stones, climbs up to the top of the mountain.
One person and one dog looked up at the top of the mountain at the same time. The young man's deep black eyes had some expectation, "The mountain should be the former family sacrificial platform of the Yu family. I hope the true soul of the white tiger is still there!"
Just as Yu Yan was about to reach the top of the mountain, countless dust suddenly fell from a white tiger statue in front of the steps, and a figure squatting on the statue appeared strangely in the dust.
The man slowly stood up on the white tiger statue, revealing a set of crimson general armor. His face was also covered with a flying squirrel mask, and only a pair of cold eyes were exposed.
The old yellow dog whimpered and hid at Yi Yan's feet, while Yi Yan stood motionless.
The crimson general's indifferent eyes glanced at Ember, and he pressed his palms to the hilt of the dagger at his waist. However, when his eyes fell on the white tiger sign at Ember's waist, he suddenly tilted his head. After a moment of silence, he slowly sat back down. The moment his indifferent eyes closed, he seemed to have turned into a motionless stone sculpture again!
Yi Yan breathed out slowly. After leaving the old and the young, he encountered no less than ten secret peeks along the way. But when he saw that the other party was about to take action, as long as he deliberately touched the White Tiger card around his waist, those peeks would quietly retreat! ~
The boy named Yu Kunlun didn't seem to be lying. People in the mountain seemed to be afraid of the tag on his waist. At the same time, he was sweating in his heart. Without this white tiger tag, he might not be able to get far even if he entered the Clan Mountain!
Yu Yan stepped up the stone steps. After taking just a few steps, the old yellow dog behind him was about to follow. Suddenly, a short sword was inserted in front of him. The fluctuation of Yuan Power flowing on it directly sent the old yellow dog flying away!
Yi Yan turned around, glanced at the crimson general, and then looked at the old yellow dog who was fine in the distance, and said: "Old Huang, you just stay here for now, I can go up alone."
The old yellow dog whimpered and lay on the ground, daring not to move.
Yu Yan began to climb up alone. On both sides of the wide barren stone steps, there were many stone sculptures of different shapes. Yu Yan found that except for the three-eyed white tiger under the crimson general, he had seen more or less the rest of the stone sculptures, and the ones he recognized were all symbols of the power of various families in Dahuang City.
Just like the symbol of the Yu family is the three-eyed white tiger, here are the Sky-Bearing Bone Python of the Nirvana Sect, the Fire-Eyed Lion of the Wang Family, the Sword-Eating Ape of the Haotian Martial Arts Hall... and so on!
After a long time, when the embers reached the top of the mountain, what came into view was a broad platform on the top of the mountain, with the skeleton of a huge beast standing on the ground.
The skeleton of the beast is completely smooth and white, and every bone on the skeleton carries an ancient and long-lasting aura. The head of the beast, which is like a hill, stares up into the sky, with a strange vertical mark between its eyebrows.
When Ember stood below, a ferocious aura from ancient times hit his face. At that moment, he seemed to see a terrifying giant beast roaring into the sky!
This is the skeleton of a three-eyed white tiger!
"The Yu family has been passed down for thousands of years, and is not much worse than the current Wu Dynasty royal family. It is said that the first generation ancestor was surrounded by a real three-eyed white tiger. Could this be..."
Yan Yan raised his head and watched. Although he didn't like the Yu family in his heart, there was still a bit of shock on his face that could not be concealed.
"It is indeed the remains of the three-eyed white tiger, but it is not the real evil spirit... It's a pity." The voice of the mysterious mask sounded in his mind.
Yi Yan calmed down and said, "What are the ten evil spirits?"
"The Ten Evil True Spirits are the most..." the mask answered in a joking voice, "You little ant doesn't deserve to know that since there are the remains of the three-eyed white tiger here, why don't you hurry up and find the traces of the true soul? It's a waste of my time!"
Ember:…
In the following time, Ember searched the entire mountain top, but unfortunately, after searching over and over again, he still found nothing.Even if he slashed the White Tiger's remains seven or eight times with a grass mustard sword, the so-called White Tiger's true soul did not appear.
"Did it really disappear?" Yi Yan frowned. All the souls in the world cannot survive forever after being separated from the physical body. Even the most special means can only delay the time.
